name: Amatsu Sora ni Saku
source:
"It's been a while since we all did something together!"
That declaration marked the beginning of our final high school summer vacation.

We've been friends since we were kids, but now, even we're confronted with differing choices of going to university, finding a job, or any of many other possibilities.

And so, it'll be the last summer we'll have that we can spend together.

"Let's make some unforgettable memories this summer!"
With that, on that steaming hot day at the height of summer, everything started.

It'll be fine, we definitely won't forget. Not even if what we see isn't real.

[Translated from [url=https://studioaila.com/amatsusora/]the official site[/url]]
